ideas.pitch: A rapid automated anomaly detection and signal classification pipeline tailored for simulated quantum-magnetometer datasets.
ideas.problem_statement: Participants will analyze extremely weak magnetic-field variations, identify meaningful patterns in the measurements, and determine the likely source or signature associated with the observed variation.
ideas.title: QuantumSig: Automated Weak Magnetic Signature Classifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact individual analytical challenge of the competition with a fast, reproducible Jupyter/Python script that handles noisy time-series data cleanly.

ideas.pitch: A Streamlit-based exploratory data analysis and visualization tool built specifically for parsing quantum-magnetometer time-series readings and isolating weak-field anomalies.
ideas.problem_statement: Participants must process the provided data, apply suitable analytical techniques, and submit the required results along with supporting analysis, code, plots or parameter estimates.
ideas.title: MagInspector: Interactive Time-Series EDA & Anomaly Profiler
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides clear, immediate visualizations and parameter estimates which judges can verify instantly via a working UI during a live review.

ideas.pitch: Applies wavelet transforms and isolation forests to decompose weak magnetic-field variations and extract precise source signatures from noisy baseline data.
ideas.problem_statement: Detect weak magnetic-field variations and determine the likely source or signature of the observed variation.
ideas.title: WaveletMag: Multi-Resolution Magnetic Source Fingerprinting
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses robust signal-processing mathematics (Wavelet analysis) ideal for extremely weak physical measurements, addressing the core analytical constraint of the competition.

ideas.pitch: An automated pipeline that ingests quantum-magnetometer data files, calculates required parameter estimates, and auto-generates comprehensive technical submission reports and plots.
ideas.problem_statement: Submit the required results along with supporting analysis, code, plots or parameter estimates as specified by the organizers.
ideas.title: MagInfer: Fast Parameter Estimator and Report Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on output quality and speed—critical for a tight 90-120 minute or fast-turnaround analytical challenge where formatting and correct parameter submission dictate qualification.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight machine learning engine optimized for detecting outlier signatures and micro-fluctuations in simulated quantum sensor data streams.
ideas.problem_statement: Participants will analyze extremely weak magnetic-field variations and identify meaningful patterns in the measurements.
ideas.title: SensorScan: Isolation Forest Magnetometer Anomaly Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages proven unsupervised anomaly detection models that train in seconds and deliver high-precision parameter estimates for evaluation metrics.
